build.command: cargo build --locked --offline --profile release -p thruline-cli --bin thruline   (cwd: the export; default features; RUSTFLAGS unset; retried without --offline only under --allow-network)

claim_output: fixtures[].claim_output, for each session that reached the store: the lengths of the claims, negated and promises arrays in claims.json, and of the claims_vs_proof and promises arrays in explain.json, plus explain.json's why_it_stopped.kind, and claims.verdicts: for each entry of claims.json's claims array, in order, the pair [kind, verdict] of that entry's values (null for an absent key, and null in place of an entry that is not an object). A value is null where its key is absent or has another type. summary.fixtures_with_claim_bearing_output counts the sessions where any of those lengths is above 0, and summary.why_it_stopped_kinds counts the kinds. When fixtures_with_claim_bearing_output is 0, this capture exercises no claim-bearing output, and an empty diff against another capture says nothing about how claims, promises or claims_vs_proof are produced or rendered. summary.fixtures_by_route counts the selected fixtures per route, 0 included. summary.spool_sessions_with_claim_bearing_output counts the route spool fixtures with claim-bearing output, and a route spool fixture without it fails the run (exit 1).
commands: route spool: the fixture's bytes copied to <WORK>/sessions/<name>/spool/claude-code.jsonl, then thruline fold --spool <that copy> --exec-db <WORK>/sessions/<name>/store/exec.db --repo <WORK>/repo --json   (never folded in place: fold writes held-back lines to a .quarantine file beside the spool)
thruline verify-receipt <that receipt, as emitted> --key <WORK>/key/signing.pub --offline --format json --exec-db <exec.db> --repo <WORK>/repo   (only for an emitted receipt)
thruline receipt <the same arguments> --trailer   (only for an emitted receipt; only the ThruLine-Receipt line is kept)

environment.cli: env -i PATH=<dir of git>:/usr/bin:/bin HOME=<WORK>/sessions/<name>/home THRULINE_HOME=<that home>/.thruline LC_ALL=C LANG=C TZ=UTC NO_COLOR=1 TERM=dumb GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null; cwd <WORK>/repo; stdin closed

work_repo.file_text: hq-invariance work repository: one fixed commit, so receipts name a non-empty tree.
work_repo.setup: git -c init.defaultBranch=main init -q --template= <WORK>/repo; write README; git add -- README; git -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -q -m <message>, under the identity below. One repository is shared by every session. The run fails if any command moves its HEAD or leaves `git status --porcelain=v1 --ignored -uall` non-empty
work_repo.why: with git's empty tree (no commit), verify-receipt fails `subject_tree` on every receipt, and each capture would record only that failure

by_route.spool: every rule above except <elapsed>, which has no ingest line to apply to, and <ULID-n> and <CHAIN_HEAD>, which are not applied. At 451b3950 fold derives each event id from session|seq|raw_sha256 (crates/capture/src/fold.rs:330-338), each fs_change and snapshot id from session|seq|path or tree, stamped 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z (:783-788, :853-859), and each check id from its exec event id (:601-606); claim and promise ids are derived from session, event and offset (crates/claims/src/extract.rs:77-86, :140-143; crates/claims/src/claim.rs:223-226). EventId::derive reads sha256 bytes as a ULID (crates/core/src/spec/event.rs:134-141), so the <ULID-n> pattern would number these ids. They and the receipt's event_chain_head stay raw, so the diff sees a change to id derivation or to section 3.1 event hashing on these sessions

normalisation.not_normalised: Everything else, including timestamps and paths carried by the fixtures themselves, the legacy ledger head ingest prints, policy and git_env digests (the latter records this machine's git defaults), every exit code, and on route spool every derived id and the receipt's event_chain_head
rules: <WORK>: the temporary work directory (as created and canonicalised); it holds every ledger, execution store, home, key and the work repository
<SRC>: the export directory the fixtures are read from
<REPO_ID>: sha256 of the work repository's path (thruline_ledger::RepoId), which is run-dependent only because the path is
<elapsed>: the number on ingest's `elapsed N ms` line (wall time; route legacy, the only route that runs ingest)
<ULID-n> (route legacy only): a 26-character ULID (the legacy ledger mints event ids from the clock at ingest), numbered by first appearance within its file

<CHAIN_HEAD> (route legacy only): a string under an event_chain_head key in a receipt payload, measured to change between two runs of the same binary on the same fixture. It is run-dependent because legacy ingest mints each event id as a ULID from the clock, import-legacy keeps that id, and the id is part of the section 3.1 hash preimage. It is replaced in that receipt, its verify-receipt output and its trailer file only when verify-receipt's chain_head check passed in-run and its detail names that same head. REACH: the diff cannot see a change to section 3.1 event hashing, and a change to event content does not show in the receipt. Such a change shows only where the content surfaces elsewhere, such as ingest's legacy `head` line in ingest.stdout.txt, which is not normalised

receipt-v*.json: the DSSE payload is stored decoded (payload_decoded) after the substitutions above; when that changed it, `payload` and each `sig` are replaced (the signature only after verify-receipt reported it passing in-run); keyid is kept; payload_normalised_sha256 is the sha256 of the normalised payload text

receipt-v*.trailer.txt: the digest is replaced only when it equals the sha256 of the emitted envelope, the --trailer run emitted the same envelope, and that envelope's payload carried a run-dependent value

not_selected.reason: Codex rollout, not a Claude Code transcript. `import-codex` (with --sessions-root or --session-file) imports only rollouts whose recorded cwd lies inside --repo, and this fixture records a synthetic cwd that no temporary repository can have (measured: rollouts_for_other_repos = 1, sessions = 0).
Redaction masking corpus (one specimen per line), not a session transcript. `ingest --apply` refuses it (measured: auto source detection found no recognized transcript envelope).

BUILD-SPEC section 3.1 hash-chain golden vector (crates/core/tests/spec_chain_golden.rs): already-chained execution events, not a harness transcript. `ingest --apply` refuses it (measured: auto source detection found no recognized transcript envelope).

ordering: Sessions and MANIFEST lists are in path order. Every stored JSON document is re-serialised with sorted keys and a 2-space indent; array order is kept exactly as emitted. This canonicalises. It is not what makes two captures of one binary equal, since a binary prints a stable order on its own. It changes bytes only where a binary prints keys in another order, and there a difference in key order alone does not show in the diff. normalisation.per_file.*.reserialised_changed_bytes records, per CLI JSON file, whether re-serialising changed any byte of what the CLI printed (after placeholder substitution). summary.cli_json_files_changed_by_reserialisation counts those files. Where it is 0, the binary already printed this form and the step changed nothing.
selection_rule: Every regular file matching crates/core/tests/fixtures/*.jsonl or crates/core/tests/fixtures/eval/*.jsonl or crates/core/tests/fixtures/claims/*.jsonl in the git archive export of the ref, in one list ordered by path (code-point order). fixtures[].route is the route of the glob the file matched. Route legacy (crates/core/tests/fixtures/*.jsonl or crates/core/tests/fixtures/eval/*.jsonl): the committed Claude Code transcript fixtures, each replayed alone through ingest and import-legacy into its own fresh ledger and execution store. Route spool (crates/core/tests/fixtures/claims/*.jsonl): committed hook and exec-recorder spool lines, each copied into the work directory and replayed alone through fold into its own fresh execution store; ingest and import-legacy are not run. Each file is one fixture session. The session name is its path under crates/core/tests/fixtures, with '/' written as '__' and '.jsonl' dropped. The session id is the `session` field of that store's `claims --last --json`. The self-checks on it differ by route (see session_identity).
session_identity: Route legacy: a store that imports more than one session fails the run, and that check cannot fire at every ref. One fixture is captured as one session, whatever it carries. Where legacy ingest keys a session by the fixture's file stem (at 457ea1ac: crates/core/src/ingest.rs:254-258, used at :811), a fixture that carries several transcript session ids is imported and captured as one session. At 457ea1ac, claude_code_sessions.jsonl carries 4 distinct values: 3 in top-level sessionId fields and 1 in a session_id field. At such refs the self-check that fails the run when import-legacy reports sessions_seen above 1 cannot fire. fixtures[].transcript_session_id_values counts the distinct string values of the top-level sessionId and session_id fields over the fixture's lines that parse as JSON objects. A fixture with more than one is printed as a NOTE and does not fail the run. Route spool: fold groups a spool's lines by their session_id string (at 451b3950: crates/capture/src/fold.rs:235-239, counted at :252-254), so a spool fixture is one session when its lines carry one session_id value. The run fails (exit 1) when fold's --json output does not carry ok true and sessions 1, or when claims --last reports a session id other than that value; a fixture whose lines carry no session_id value, or several, has no such value and fails. Before any capture, a spool fixture with an exec line (a spec_payload whose kind is exec) that does not name the work repository's tree as input_tree_hash refuses the run (exit 2).

signing_key.seed: 32 zero bytes: a public test key that proves nothing about authorship

wall_clock_guard: Every output file, MANIFEST.json included, is scanned for a YYYY-MM-DD date within one day of the run and for a 10-digit epoch-seconds or 13-digit epoch-milliseconds number within one day of the run. A hit carried by no selected fixture fails the run (exit 1). A hit a fixture carries is printed as a NOTE.
